content: Residents of Canada can contact 1-844-764-7669 for assistance. Important Notes: Appetite suppressants should never be used as a substitute for a proper, balanced diet. Do not share this medication with others, as it is prescribed specifically for you. It is essential to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose Instructions: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose or late in the evening, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company for guidance on safe disposal. Overdose Instructions: In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Important Information About This Product: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible information about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete details about this product and your individual health needs.
